title: Wikipedia’s Secret Signs of AI Writing Exposed!
description:
The Signs of AI Writing - Wikipedia just published a guide to spotting AI-generated writing, and it's the best one on the internet. ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and the other AI chatbots (LLMs) still write in a predictable way, with lots of cliché phrases and words, as well as little text formatting quirks that give it away.
